parsed.rationale: The rhythm is irregularly irregular, with R-R intervals varying from about 2 to 6 large boxes. There are no discernible P waves and the baseline is fibrillatory, so this is not normal; the voltage in V4–V5 is also very high, suggesting LVH. The ST elevation in V2–V3 is the concave pattern that follows deep S waves, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
